playbooks.name: HYPE Fee Monitor & Burn Predictor
playbooks.description: Monitors Hyperliquid Assistance Fund fees every 30 minutes via onchain + API. Calculates HYPE buyback/burn rate, order book imbalance, and estimates HYPE price at T+1h, T+4h, T+24h using a calibrated elasticity model. Generates BOUNCE_HIGH / BURN_SPIKE / FEE_DROP signals. Signal-only engine — no autonomous entries.
